metadata.note: Hand-authored: K2 is not in the Cloudflare API reference yet. The control plane (/accounts/{account_id}/k2/streams…) is transcribed from cloudflare/api-schemas openapi.json (cloudflare-k2_* schemas); the data plane (https://{stream_id}.k2.cloudflarestorage.com, operations with com.cloudflare.protocols#host) from developers.cloudflare.com/k2/features/{produce,consume}. Both were verified against the live API on 2026-10-05. Delete this file when the docs gain a k2 resource.

10212 (HTTP 503): K2 could not append the batch and it MAY have been stored. K2 does not deduplicate, so retrying can store it twice; never retried automatically.
10217: K2 is still reading a batch for this worker_id from an earlier request. Retry to receive it.
10204: the request is invalid (malformed JSON or base64, a field out of range, both inputs disabled, an empty batch).
10218: the lease is no longer held by this worker (expired, released, acknowledged, or redelivered). Do not retry; consume a new batch.
10216: every one of the subscription's 128 leases is held. Retry after a lease is acknowledged, released, or expires.
10201: a stream with this name exists, or a subscription with this name exists with different settings.
10214: K2 could not read records from storage. Retry the request.
10207: a record exceeds 1 MB (content and headers combined).
10206: the produce request exceeds 5 MB, before or after decompression.
10200: the stream does not exist (or, on produce, the input is not enabled).
10219: the stream already has the maximum of 100 subscriptions.
10215: the subscription does not exist.
10211: K2 is temporarily unavailable. On produce the batch was NOT stored; retry it.
